Short, clear answers

The answers below describe this introduction and Chùa Mây's official entry points.

What is Chùa Mây?

It is an online space for the lunar calendar and quiet remembrance.

Where can I open Chùa Mây?

You can open it on the web or in Telegram using the home-page links.

Does this site require a sign-in?

You can read this introduction without signing in. Some app functions may require identity verification.
